title: An Especially Noble Calling
speaker: Joy D. Jones
speaker_role: Primary General President
kicker: As women of faith, we can draw principles of truth from the Prophet Joseph’s experiences that provide insights for receiving our own revelation.

title: Prayers of Faith
speaker: Henry B. Eyring
speaker_role: Second Counselor in the First Presidency
kicker: As we pray in faith, we become a vital part in the Lord’s work as He prepares the world for His Second Coming.

title: The Coming Forth of the Book of Mormon
speaker: Ulisses Soares
speaker_role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
kicker: The historical facts and the special witnesses of the Book of Mormon testify that its coming forth was indeed miraculous.

title: United in Accomplishing God’s Work
speaker: Jean B. Bingham
speaker_role: Relief Society General President
kicker: The most effective way to fulfill our divine potential is to work together, blessed by the power and authority of the priesthood.

title: That They May See
speaker: Bonnie H. Cordon
speaker_role: Young Women General President
kicker: Look and pray for opportunities to let your light shine that others may see the way to Jesus Christ.

title: Hear Him
speaker: Russell M. Nelson
speaker_role: President of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
kicker: Our Father knows that when we are surrounded by uncertainty and fear, what will help us the very most is to hear His Son.

title: Finding Refuge from the Storms of Life
speaker: Ricardo P. Giménez
speaker_role: Of the Seventy
kicker: Jesus Christ and His Atonement are the refuge that we all need, regardless of the storms that are battering our lives.

title: We Will Prove Them Herewith
speaker: David A. Bednar
speaker_role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
kicker: Now is the time to prepare and prove ourselves willing and able to do all things whatsoever the Lord our God shall command us.

title: Eyes to See
speaker: Michelle D. Craig
speaker_role: First Counselor in the Young Women General Presidency
kicker: Through the power of the Holy Ghost, Christ will enable us to see ourselves and see others as He does.

title: Hearts Knit in Righteousness and Unity
speaker: Quentin L. Cook
speaker_role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
kicker: At this 200-year hinge point in our Church history, let us commit ourselves to live righteously and be united as never before.

title: Love Your Enemies
speaker: Dallin H. Oaks
speaker_role: First Counselor in the First Presidency
kicker: Knowing that we are all children of God gives us a vision of the worth of others and the ability to rise above prejudice.

title: God Will Do Something Unimaginable
speaker: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
speaker_role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
kicker: God has prepared His children and His Church for this time.

title: By Union of Feeling We Obtain Power with God
speaker: Sharon Eubank
speaker_role: First Counselor in the Relief Society General Presidency
kicker: As we seek union of feeling, we will call down the power of God to make our efforts whole.

title: The Healing Power of Jesus Christ
speaker: Cristina B. Franco
speaker_role: Second Counselor in the Primary General Presidency
kicker: As we come unto Jesus Christ by exercising faith in Him, repenting, and making and keeping covenants, our brokenness—whatever its cause—can be healed.

title: Embrace the Future with Faith
speaker: Russell M. Nelson
speaker_role: President of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
kicker: The future will be glorious for those who are prepared and who continue to prepare to be instruments in the Lord’s hands.

title: Let God Prevail
speaker: Russell M. Nelson
speaker_role: President of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
kicker: Are you willing to let God prevail in your life? Are you willing to let God be the most important influence in your life?

title: Never Give Up an Opportunity to Testify of Christ
speaker: Bonnie H. Cordon
speaker_role: Young Women General President
kicker: True joy rests on our willingness to come closer to Christ and witness for ourselves.

title: Ministering
speaker: Gerrit W. Gong
speaker_role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
kicker: Let us reach out and care as our Savior would, especially to those whom we are privileged by love and assignment to minister.

title: Finding Personal Peace
speaker: Henry B. Eyring
speaker_role: Second Counselor in the First Presidency
kicker: I pray that you may find peace, help many others to find it, and pass it along.

title: Accessing God’s Power through Covenants
speaker: Dale G. Renlund
speaker_role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
kicker: As you walk the covenant path, from baptism to the temple and throughout life, I promise you power to go against the natural worldly flow.

title: Jesus Christ Is the Strength of Parents
speaker: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
speaker_role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
kicker: Help your children build faith in Jesus Christ, love His gospel and His Church, and prepare for a lifetime of righteous choices.

title: One in Christ
speaker: D. Todd Christofferson
speaker_role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
kicker: It is only in and through our individual loyalty to and love of Jesus Christ that we can hope to be one.

title: Jesus Christ Is Relief
speaker: Camille N. Johnson
speaker_role: Relief Society General President
kicker: We can partner with the Savior to help provide temporal and spiritual relief for those in need—and in the process find our own relief.

title: Followers of the Prince of Peace
speaker: Ulisses Soares
speaker_role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
kicker: As we strive to develop attributes like the Savior’s, we can become instruments of His peace in the world.

title: Peacemakers Needed
speaker: Russell M. Nelson
speaker_role: President of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
kicker: You have your agency to choose contention or reconciliation. I urge you to choose to be a peacemaker, now and always.

title: “Abide in Me, and I in You; Therefore Walk with Me”
speaker: David A. Bednar
speaker_role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
kicker: The Savior’s promise to abide in us is true and available to every covenant-keeping member of His restored Church.

title: In the Path of Their Duty
speaker: David A. Bednar
speaker_role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
kicker: You who today are pressing forward in the path of your duty are the strength of the Savior’s restored Church.

title: Abide the Day in Christ
speaker: Amy A. Wright
speaker_role: First Counselor in the Primary General Presidency
kicker: Jesus Christ makes it possible for us to “abide the day.”

title: Sir, We Would Like to See Jesus
speaker: Robert M. Daines
speaker_role: Of the Seventy
kicker: We want to see Jesus for who He is and to feel His love.

title: For the Sake of Your Posterity
speaker: Carlos A. Godoy
speaker_role: Of the Presidency of the Seventy
kicker: Don’t be the weak link in this beautiful chain of faith you started, or you received, as a legacy. Be the strong one.

title: The Sealing Power
speaker: D. Todd Christofferson
speaker_role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
kicker: The sealing power makes individual salvation and family exaltation universally available to the children of God.

title: Love Thy Neighbour
speaker: Ian S. Ardern
speaker_role: Of the Seventy
kicker: Compassion is an attribute of Christ. It is born of love for others and knows no boundaries.

title: Kingdoms of Glory
speaker: Dallin H. Oaks
speaker_role: First Counselor in the First Presidency
kicker: We have a loving Heavenly Father who will see that we receive every blessing and every advantage that our own desires and choices allow.

title: Preserving the Voice of the Covenant People in the Rising Generation
speaker: Jan E. Newman
speaker_role: Second Counselor in the Sunday School General Presidency
kicker: One of our most sacred responsibilities is to help our children come to know deeply and specifically that Jesus is the Christ.

title: The Power of Jesus Christ in Our Lives Every Day
speaker: Joaquin E. Costa
speaker_role: Of the Seventy
kicker: The source of our strength is faith in Jesus Christ as we intentionally seek to come unto Him each and every day.

title: Promptings of the Spirit
speaker: Gary E. Stevenson
speaker_role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
kicker: The constant companionship of the Holy Ghost is one of the greatest spiritual gifts Latter-day Saints enjoy.

title: Spiritually Whole in Him
speaker: Camille N. Johnson
speaker_role: Relief Society General President
kicker: Wholeness does not necessarily mean physical and emotional restoration in this life. Wholeness is born of faith in and conversion to Jesus Christ.

title: “Draw Near unto Me”
speaker: Henry B. Eyring
speaker_role: Second Counselor in the First Presidency
kicker: Jesus Christ loves each of us. He offers us the opportunity to draw closer to Him.

title: Cherishing Life
speaker: Neil L. Andersen
speaker_role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
kicker: Life is a most precious part of our Father’s perfect plan, and by His decree we cherish and preserve life.

title: “Return unto Me … That I May Heal You”
speaker: S. Mark Palmer
speaker_role: Of the Presidency of the Seventy
kicker: There is rejoicing in heaven over those who return. It is not too late for you to come back.

title: Faith: A Bond of Trust and Loyalty
speaker: Sandino Roman
speaker_role: Of the Seventy
kicker: Faith sprouts as we trust in Jesus Christ and blooms as we are faithful and loyal to Him.

title: “By This All Will Know That You Are My Disciples”
speaker: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
speaker_role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
kicker: Our love for God and His children is a powerful testimony to the world that this is truly the Savior’s Church.

title: Thou Art the Christ
speaker: Amy A. Wright
speaker_role: First Counselor in the Primary General Presidency
kicker: We want our children to believe in Jesus Christ, belong to Jesus Christ and His Church through covenant, and strive to become like Jesus Christ.

title: Your Repentance Doesn’t Burden Jesus Christ; It Brightens His Joy
speaker: Tamara W. Runia
speaker_role: First Counselor in the Young Women General Presidency
kicker: The invitation to repent is an expression of God’s love. Saying yes to that invitation is an expression of ours.

title: Charity—a Sign of True Discipleship
speaker: Michael B. Strong
speaker_role: Of the Seventy
kicker: The real destination of discipleship is literally to become as Jesus Christ is.

title: Confidence in the Presence of God
speaker: Russell M. Nelson
speaker_role: President of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
kicker: As we diligently seek to have charity and virtue fill our lives, our confidence in approaching God will increase.

title: Blessed Are the Peacemakers
speaker: Gary E. Stevenson
speaker_role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
kicker: Peacemaking still begins in the most basic place—in our hearts. Then in homes and families.

title: Tune Your Heart to Jesus Christ: The Sacred Gift of Primary Music
speaker: Tracy Y. Browning
speaker_role: Second Counselor in the Primary General Presidency
kicker: Primary songs are sermons for disciples of Jesus Christ, testimonies to the truthfulness of the restored gospel, and prayers set to music.

title: Know Who You Really Are
speaker: Brik V. Eyre
speaker_role: Of the Seventy
kicker: Regardless of where we are on our path of discipleship, our lives will fundamentally change if we better understand who we really are.

title: Be Reconciled to God
speaker: Kelly R. Johnson
speaker_role: Of the Seventy
kicker: Reconciliation to God, through Jesus Christ’s Atonement, leads to unshakable faith.

title: Humble Souls at Altars Kneel
speaker: Jeremy R. Jaggi
speaker_role: Of the Seventy
kicker: As we make and honor our covenants, we bind ourselves to the Savior, gaining greater access to His mercy, protection, sanctification, healing, and rest.

title: The Eternal Gift of Testimony
speaker: Kevin G. Brown
speaker_role: Of the Seventy
kicker: Every son or daughter of God can gain a deeper, firmer, and surer knowledge for themselves.
